page.layout: One column of running text on one printed page. Running head across the top, page number at top left. No marginal notes and no footnotes. Nothing below the text except the catchword at the right.

main_text.p: Ut cedat optimè universis, nulla melius ac-[?]tione efficietur, quam si æquo, honesto & gravi more Omnes simul consilia in commune conferant, publico omnia consensu agantur sine Tumultu & Tyrannide, non enim ideo nos fame necare oportet, quia salubres cibi nonnullis in naufeam & morbum vertuntur.

Sin eò res devenerit, ut in Jura nostra Regia nunquam amplius restituamur, & id scilicet vera Dei Justitia poscente perstituri [?] sint usque Subditi Mei in peccatis suis, & prospero scelere deludendi: Spero Gratiam Divinam id in Te & Me effecturam, ut simus æque carendo Diademati ac gestando pares; quod profecto tanti non est ut inhonestis, sordidis, & impiis conditionibus aut servari mereatur, aut ab humo sustolli. Firmus Pietati & Virtuti maneas, nunquam Regnum deerit.

In hoc vero potissimum Honori tuo consules, quo omne promptius reverentiam & amorem detuleris, & in præsidium porro te stiteris Uxori Meæ, Matri Tuæ, de Me plurimis nominibus optime meritæ, & in his præcipue, quæ (cum Me tot prius liberis summæ spei auxisset, quos omnes unà cum Matre Amori Tuo & fidei commendo) raro magnanimitatis & Patientiæ exemplo pro Me & Te simul & nobiscum unà perpessa est.
Deum Omnipotentem veneror quicquid de Me facturus est, qui Innocentiâ Meâ & illius Gratiâ involvor satis & munior, ut te An-choram protollat vel potius Calami-

page.notes: The first line of the second paragraph and the page break in the first paragraph ("ac-[?]tione") are doubtful: the line-end hyphen is hard to make out. "perstituri" is hard to read, so I marked it [?]. The running head is set in Greek capitals (ΕΙΚΩΝ ΒΑΣΙΛΙΚΗ); the last letter reads as H and the Ω may be a Latin-looking letter in print. The long s is transcribed as plain s throughout, and the printed u/v and i/j forms are normalised. The small dots and marks beside "publico" and "quia" and the mark at the right edge are typesetting marks, not text, so I left them out.
